name: Affinity
summary: Relationship intelligence CRM for dealmaking firms.

flows.title: Create a person or organization
steps: Click the + Add New button in the bottom-left corner, then click Add Person, Add Organization, or New Opportunity.
For a person, enter the first and last name (required) and, ideally, an email address. For an organization, enter the organization name (required) and, ideally, its URL.

flows.title: Find a warm introduction to a contact
steps: Press Cmd+K (Mac) or Alt+K (Windows) to open quick search, and type the person's or company's name.
On the contact's profile, click the Connections tab to see which of your colleagues has the strongest relationship with them.
Click the team member with the strongest connection to review their activity timeline with this contact — emails, meetings, and notes.
Reach out to your colleague to ask for the introduction, then log it in Affinity once they make it.

flows.title: Log an interaction
steps: Click + Add New on the bottom-left of the global navigation sidebar, or, from a contact's profile page, click the dropdown arrow and click Log Interaction.
Choose an interaction type — Meeting, Call, or Message — and specify the date and time it took place.

Add the people you interacted with in the Participants field, and add any other people, organizations, or opportunities discussed in the Add note to field. At least one participant must be an external contact, someone outside your team, or Publish shows an error.
Write your note, then click Publish.
